Name: Custom Critters Dragonflies
Author: lamplight12347
Description:
!! Code is not my own !!
The original is from [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1259]Eemie's Bees[/url] 

Mod requires [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1255]Custom Critters[/url] to work but as that no longer works on SMAPI the [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/updating-mods-for-stardew-valley-1-4.156000/page-27#post-3354372]Unofficial Patch[/url] is also required


Even with Eemie's Bees and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5506]Squiver's Moths[/url]﻿ my farm still felt like it needed a little bit more life, so I added dragonflies, they come in six different colors green, blue, yellow, red, pink and orange!

If you have any requests for new colors or changes to original colors please comment!
